capabilities: search the official community plugin directory with local keyword matching
install and update community plugins through GitHub proxy mirrors
install selected stable or Alpha releases of Wujie Sync, Wujie Translate, and Smart Sync
verify downloaded release files against SHA-256 digests
back up plugin release files before installing or updating
disambiguation: Not a vault-sync tool despite handling Wujie Sync releases; it only installs and updates plugin files, leaving enable, disable, and uninstall to Obsidian's own settings.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.12.0 or later. The README warns that the six relay proxies (ghfast.top, gh-proxy.com, gh.llkk.cc, ghproxy.net, gh.monlor.com, wget.la) can see the GitHub URLs they relay and that ordinary community downloads have no independently trusted publisher hashes. A crash during install or update may require manually restoring files from the pmcn-backups directory. Mobile and minimum-version runtime acceptance are still pending. problem: Obsidian's official plugin directory and release downloads route through GitHub, which is slow or unreliable to reach from mainland China networks.
